item.text: {"summary":"The forecast is coherent and well-traced, but publication is blocked by a verified resolution-date mismatch in the canonical target ledger.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"blocking","summary":"The draft correctly preserves the ledger’s 2026-08-20 resolutionDate, but its cited official Statistics Canada release calendar identifies the June 2026 Employment Insurance release as 2026-08-21.","actionRequested":"Escalate and correct/re-register the canonical target’s resolutionDate and expected release window before publication; keep this forecast bound to the same target rather than changing its resolver fields independently."}],"optionalSuggestions":["If the target is re-registered, update the forecast’s resolver metadata to the corrected canonical contract and retain the documented first-print rule."]}
